title: Nested Walk-Forward OOF Prediction Factory
mission: Create the authoritative out-of-fold prediction factory for every expert, specialist and baseline across long and modern frames.
steps: Define expanding outer folds and inner tuning folds per frame.
Recompute all fold-fitted transformations inside folds.
Train/predict every expert for every eligible test date.
Store model/config/data hashes and support counts.
Create common-row meta-training tables with availability masks.
Prevent any final/sealed outcomes from hyperparameter selection.
acceptance: Every prediction traceable to fold artifact
failure: Expert missing on date: availability mask; never substitute its fitted full-sample prediction
